_about: George Darley. Bloom's Western Canon (1994) lists: Nepenthe; Poems. Bloom addition 2026-11-03 under Adam's Bloom-only ruling; each row is US public domain (title page, Gutenberg header or IA metadata read, recorded in _bloom).

darley-nepenthe: Nepenthe: A Poem in Two Cantos
darley-poems-late: Poems of the Late George Darley

darley-nepenthe.year: 1897 (title page 'LONDON ELKIN MATHEWS, VIGO STREET MDCCCXCVII')
darley-nepenthe.evidence: Read djvu title page. Collection cdl/americana.
darley-nepenthe.case: Bloom lists Nepenthe; nothing by George Darley is held (the darley shelf is J. R. Darley, a different man). The 1897 Elkin Mathews reprint is the accessible text.
darley-nepenthe.note: The 'author' match in the chunk was to John Richard Darley, not George.

darley-poems-late.year: unread (IA says [1889?]; title page has no date; Liverpool: A. Holden)
darley-poems-late.evidence: Read djvu title page and contents (Memoir; Lenimina Laborum...). Collection cdl/americana.
darley-poems-late.case: Bloom lists Darley's poems; this memorial collection is the 19th-century gathering of them.
darley-poems-late.note: Undated on the page but Darley died 1846 and the volume is plainly 19th-century. IA also has 'Selections from the Poems of George Darley' (1904, selectionsfromp00darlgoog; not opened). Colles's 1908 Complete Poetical Works (Muses' Library) would be better if found.
